title: Seeking Secrets, Part 3
description: Seeking Secrets, Part 3 — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Sir Ving N'Seacressy

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Die in the Haxhaxor Libraritorium off Level 5 in the Shadow's Embrace, journey through the underlife, and steal the secret plans from the R&D lab. Afterward, meet with Sir Ving N'Seacressy in the Shadow's Gate.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Sir Ving N'Seacressy

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Seeking Secrets, Part 4

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Die in the Haxhaxor Libraritorium off Level 5 in the Shadow's Embrace, journey through the underlife, and steal the secret plans from the R&D lab. Afterward, meet with Sir Ving N'Seacressy in the Shadow's Gate.

Offer:

Let's say that I accidently dropped the latest secret documents you left here. And maybe I accidently started reading them while picking everything up off the floor.

It turns out that the Guild of Shadows feels the kingdom's automatic resurrection system is bad for the assassin business, and they want people to start dying again--like in the old days before the res system.

We know who and why...but now we need to know how. I'm not saying there is, but let's assume there might be another Resurrection & Development lab that I heard about, this one in the Haxhaxor Libraritorium off Level 5 in the Shadow's Embrace. If you were to die in the Haxhaxor Libraritorium, journey through the underlife into the lab and grab the secret plans, well, I'm sure someone in this immediate vicinity would be very grateful.

Turn-in:

Have some papers to deliver? Well, there's no courier here, but I'll hold onto them until one gets here. *wink!*

Objectives:

  • Secret Operation: Dante's Cheesebox ×1

Level range: 45–100
